metadata.llm_reason: Candidate 'Custom Observation Convention Registration' is a generic bean registration wrapper around two distinct implementation patterns already captured by peer skills: (1) implementing ServerRequestObservationConvention from scratch (f83a5625), and (2) extending DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention to preserve defaults (89957de2). The candidate adds no new semantic capability—it merely describes the @Configuration/@Bean registration pattern common to both. Merging consolidates redundant guidance and eliminates the intermediate abstraction layer.
